title: Monopsony and Backloaded Compensation: Theory and Evidence from Public Accountants
title_zh: 买方垄断与延迟补偿：来自公共会计师的理论与证据
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In monopsony models, wage markdowns induce deadweight loss and are therefore inefficient. Yet markdowns also arise in models with backloaded efficiency pay, where they are designed to induce effort among early-career workers and are thus efficient. To reconcile—and empirically distinguish—these two mechanisms, we build a dynamic model incorporating labor market power and endogenous effort. Estimating a team production model on novel data on U.S. public accounting firms, we find evidence of both: markdowns for junior workers and markups for senior ones reflect incentive-providing backloading, while monopsony power induces a ‘lifetime’ wage markdown of 15%.
abstract_zh: 在买方垄断模型中，工资折价会导致无谓损失，因此是低效的。然而，在具有后置效率薪酬的模型中，折价现象同样存在，其设计目的是激励早期职业员工付出努力，因此是高效的。为调和并实证区分这两种机制，我们构建了一个融合劳动力市场势力与内生努力的动态模型。基于美国会计师事务所的新数据集，我们通过团队生产模型估计发现两种机制并存：初级员工的折价与高级员工的溢价反映了激励导向的后置薪酬安排，而买方垄断势力则导致15%的"终身"工资折价。

title: Beyond the Urban Sweet Spot: Firm-Level Evidence of Over-Agglomeration in Mongolia’s Capital
title_zh: 超越城市甜点：蒙古首都过度集聚的企业层面证据
authors: Diaz Sanchez, Jose Luis, Lkhagvasuren, Mijiddorj
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides the first firm-level assessment of agglomeration economies in Mongolia, focusing on Ulaanbaatar, the country’s dominant urban center. Using data from the 2021 Enterprise Census, the paper estimates total factor productivity for a large sample of enter-prises and examines its relationship with localization, urban diversity, and peer productivity. The results indicate robust positive agglomeration effects, alongside suggestive evidence of diminishing returns to localization consistent with an inverted U-shaped pattern. These non-linearities are most apparent in Ulaanbaatar and in manufacturing, although they prove sensitive to alternative agglomeration and productivity measures. Although the cross-sectional nature of the data limits causal inference, the analysis offers new micro-level evidence on how spatial concentration interacts with congestion, infrastructure strain, and potential spatial misallocation. The findings underscore the importance of urban planning, infrastructure investment, and the development of regional hubs to sustain productivity growth in Mongolia’s highly concentrated urban system, with implications for diversification beyond mining in resource-dependent economies.
abstract_zh: 本文首次从企业层面评估蒙古国的集聚经济效应，重点关注该国主导城市中心乌兰巴托。利用2021年企业普查数据，本文估算了大量样本企业的全要素生产率，并考察其与本地化经济、城市多样性及同行生产率之间的关系。结果表明，存在稳健的正向集聚效应，同时有迹象显示本地化经济存在递减收益，符合倒U型模式。这些非线性特征在乌兰巴托及制造业中最为显著，但对替代性集聚指标与生产率指标的敏感性较高。尽管数据的横截面性质限制了因果推断，但分析为空间集中如何与拥挤效应、基础设施压力及潜在的空间错配相互作用提供了新的微观证据。研究结果凸显了城市规划、基础设施投资及区域中心建设对维持蒙古国高度集中城市体系中生产率增长的重要性，并对资源依赖型经济体实现矿业以外的多元化发展具有启示意义。

title: Hidden Vulnerability and Heat-Triggered Decompensation: Rethinking Urban Overheating Beyond Clinical Risk
title_zh: 隐性脆弱性与热触发失代偿：超越临床风险的城市过热再思考
authors: Zhu, Mingyu, Zhao, Qunshan, Jin, Jiayi
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Urban overheating is increasingly recognised as a major public health challenge under climate change, yet existing frameworks remain heavily focused on acute medical risk and clinically vulnerable populations. This paper introduces \textit{hidden vulnerability} to describe a broader population who remain socially and economically active under ordinary conditions but experience progressive destabilisation during sustained indoor heat exposure. Drawing on a sensor-enhanced longitudinal housing survey in Southwark, London during the summer of 2023, combining indoor environmental monitoring with weekly health and wellbeing questionnaires, the study examines how overheating affects everyday urban life. The findings reveal that impacts extended well beyond thermal discomfort. Participants described cascading disruptions across physical, functional, and psychological domains, sleep loss, exhaustion, impaired self-care, reduced concentration, emotional strain, and increased caring burdens, that interacted and reinforced one another, progressively eroding the capacity to maintain ordinary routines. Critically, these processes were observed not only among participants with chronic conditions but also among those without formally recognised health vulnerabilities, suggesting that the threshold for destabilisation is lower, and more widely distributed, than existing frameworks assume. The paper argues that hidden vulnerability is an urban condition, produced by the intersection of housing quality, social infrastructure, and accumulated disadvantage. The response calls for a conceptual framework for redefining heat vulnerability beyond demographic and clinical categories, and an empirical foundation for a social cure approach to urban heat governance.
abstract_zh: 城市过热日益被视为气候变化下的一项重大公共健康挑战，然而现有研究框架仍高度聚焦于急性医疗风险及临床意义上的脆弱人群。本文提出"隐性脆弱性"概念，用以描述在常规条件下保持社会与经济活跃、但持续暴露于室内高温时经历渐进式失稳的广泛人群。基于2023年夏季在伦敦南华克区开展的传感器增强型纵向住房调查，结合室内环境监测与每周健康福祉问卷，本研究考察了过热对日常城市生活的影响。研究结果表明，其影响远超热不适范畴。参与者描述了身体、功能及心理层面的级联式干扰——睡眠剥夺、疲惫、自我照护能力受损、注意力下降、情绪压力及照护负担加重——这些因素相互交织、彼此强化，逐步侵蚀维持日常活动的能力。关键的是，这些过程不仅出现在患有慢性疾病的参与者中，也出现在无正式认定的健康脆弱性的参与者中，表明失稳阈值低于现有框架假设，且分布更为广泛。本文认为，隐性脆弱性是一种城市状态，由住房质量、社会基础设施与累积劣势的交织作用所产生。应对策略要求构建超越人口统计与临床分类的热脆弱性概念框架，并为城市热治理的社会疗愈路径提供实证基础。

title: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
title_zh: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验
abstract: We introduce an overidentification test of two alternative assumptions to identify the average treatment effect on the treated in a two‐period panel data setting: unconfoundedness and common trends. Under unconfoundedness, treatment assignment and post‐treatment outcomes are independent, conditional on control variables and pre‐treatment outcomes, which motivates including the pre‐treatment outcomes in the set of controls. Under common trends, the trend and the treatment assignment are independent, conditional on control variables, motivating a Difference‐in‐Differences (DiD) approach. Given the non‐nested nature of these assumptions and their often ambiguous plausibility in empirical settings, we propose a joint test using a doubly robust statistic that can be combined with machine learning to control for observed confounders in a data‐driven manner. We discuss causal models satisfying either common trends, unconfoundedness, or both assumptions. Applying the proposed method to publicly available datasets, we find that the test rejects the null hypothesis in two out of four cases.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种过度识别检验方法，用于评估两期面板数据中识别处理组平均处理效应的两种替代假设：无混杂性与共同趋势。在无混杂性假设下，处理分配与处理后结果在控制变量和处理前结果条件下相互独立，这促使将处理前结果纳入控制变量集。在共同趋势假设下，趋势与处理分配在控制变量条件下相互独立，这推动了双重差分法的应用。鉴于这两种假设的非嵌套性质及其在实证情境中常存的模糊合理性，我们提出一种联合检验方法，采用双重稳健统计量，可结合机器学习以数据驱动方式控制观测混杂因素。我们讨论了满足共同趋势、无混杂性或两者兼具的因果模型。将所提方法应用于公开数据集后，发现检验在四个案例中有两个拒绝了原假设。
